preprocessing: drift-tracking baseline = P10 inside 2400 sample blocks, interpolated between block centres
occupancy label = excess > max(1.5 dB, 5.0 * noise) -- reference label, not absolute truth
focus code 60 pinned (station publishes interleaved sweeps)
